subject: Commercial redline triage & SOW integration plan
messages:
From: Harrison Cole <h.cole@medlytics.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Sep 2026 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: SOW edits and pricing for Q4 ramp

Hi Stephanie,

We're ramping faster than expected into Q4 and I need help updating our statement of work and order form. Two asks: 1) add 250k token throughput (phased over Oct–Dec), and 2) review the pricing floor for higher monthly volume — our procurement team is pushing back on the current tier.

I've attached our suggested edits (Medlytics_Redlines_v1.docx) — mostly the Exhibit A throughput table and a few MSA notes around data retention. Can we get a commercial redline + implementation timeline by next Monday (21st)?

Also, please include any changes that would affect SLA/uptime credits and billing proration.

Thanks,
Harrison Cole
Director, Platform Ops
Medlytics
(attachment: Medlytics_Redlines_v1.docx)

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Harrison Cole <h.cole@medlytics.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Sep 2026 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: SOW edits and pricing for Q4 ramp

Thanks Harrison — got the redlines. Looping in Karthik for pricing and Neha for legal redline guidance.

Quick plan:
- Internal triage today (commercial + legal)
- Consolidated amendment draft by Fri EOD 18th
- Final amendment + DocuSign by Mon 21st (target)

Karthik — can you run a short pricing scenario (3-tier view: current, committed +10%, committed +30%) and show impact to monthly unit price and potential credits? Neha — please flag any MSA clauses that conflict with the customer's requested data-retention language; we can propose narrow carve-ins.

Harrison — we'll keep the implementation timeline aligned with Laura (CS) once legal/commercial align.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Cc: Harrison Cole <h.cole@medlytics.com>
Date: Wed, 16 Sep 2026 09:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Pricing scenarios for Medlytics throughput add

Folks — attached a quick worksheet (proposed_price_recon.xlsx) with three scenarios. Key bullets:

- Current (no change): monthly unit price $0.015/token, price stair at 1M tokens
- Committed +10% (250k phased): propose $0.0135/token with a 12-month commit (saves ~10%)
- Committed +30% (aggressive): propose $0.012/token with 24-month tiered commit and an optional CPI step-down at 12 months

Operational note: if we implement aggressive discounting we should preserve an SLA carve-out for burst capacity (separate billing).

Attaching line-item math. Pick the scenario you want me to bake into the amendment and I'll produce redline-friendly language.

(attachment: proposed_price_recon.xlsx)

—Karthik

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 17 Sep 2026 14:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pricing scenarios for Medlytics throughput add

Stephanie / Karthik — thanks. I reviewed the customer's redlines and flagged areas; attached is a tracked MSA (redline_msa.docx) with comments. Summary:

- Data retention: customer requests explicit 90-day KV-cache retention language; propose we accept for read-only caches but preserve control-plane logs retention per our standard policy.
- Indemnity/PII: customer's request to remove vendor liability caps is a no-go; propose tightening language around scope of processing and offering enhanced SOC 2 + Attestation instead.
- Billing proration: suggest we keep as-is but add an examples section (billing illustration) to avoid procurement confusion.

I'll insert short callouts for the amendment draft where legal wants specific wording. 

(attachment: redline_msa.docx)

—Neha

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Harrison Cole <h.cole@medlytics.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Sep 2026 08:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Implementation acceptance criteria + schedule

Hi all — quick operational input for the SOW changes so the amendment includes a clear cutover plan:

Acceptance criteria (must be testable):
- Token throughput validated at staging with sustained 90th-percentile latency < 300ms for 95% of requests
- Prefix/KV cache warming steps documented and performed prior to full cutover
- Playbook for rollback within 30 minutes if latency exceeds thresholds during first 48 hours

Proposed schedule (aligned to customer ramp):
- Week 1 (Nov): staging capacity increase + bench tests
- Week 2 (Nov): small-scale canary at 25% traffic
- Week 3 (Nov): full cutover + 48-hour monitoring window

If legal/commercial want acceptance tied to billing milestones we can include a 14-day acceptance period after cutover. Happy to write the SOW paragraph and hand it to legal for insertion.

—Laura
